description: This header file defines template classes for B-tree based set and multiset containers (`absl::btree_set` and `absl::btree_multiset`) that are optimized for efficiency and cache performance, providing a drop-in replacement for STL's `std::set` and `std::multiset` with some API differences. It includes class definitions, member functions, and internal policies for managing B-tree nodes.

classes.name: btree_set
classes.description: A template class implementing a B-tree based ordered set of unique keys, supporting standard set operations with efficiency improvements over STL.

classes.name: btree_multiset
classes.description: A template class implementing a B-tree based multiset allowing duplicate keys, optimized for performance and cache efficiency.

classes.name: set_slot_policy
classes.description: Internal policy struct for managing slot operations in B-tree set containers.

classes.name: set_params
classes.description: Template struct holding configuration parameters for B-tree set containers, including key, compare, allocator, node size, and multiplicity.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two B-tree set or multiset containers.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: Removes all elements satisfying a predicate from a B-tree set or multiset, returning the count of erased elements.
